title: Chastity and the First Stirrings of Instinct: An Early Conversation
summary: With adolescence, the instinct awakens and temptations surround. Your silence leaves him to distorted sources. Speak to him with dignity about 'iffah (chastity) and haya (modesty), and self-restraint through fasting and keeping busy. Keep your door open for his questions without shame.
try_this: This week: Initiate a calm dialogue about haya and 'iffah from the angle of strength, not shame, and listen to his perspective.
reflection_prompts: Can your teenager ask you about these matters?
